correctness.rationale: The Markov generator for σ∈{−1,0,+1} gives p_n=q_(n−1), (n+a)q_n=n h_(n−1) and (n+a+c)h_n=(n+c)p_n. Compact support determines the even moment recurrence. Independent Beta(c/2,a/2) and Beta(1/2,a/2) moments match exactly, including zero odd moments. Substitution c=s a(a+1)/(1−s(a+1)) for 0<a<(1−s)/s yields T_s. Its derivative has sign −Q_s(y), where Q_s(0)=5s>0,Q_s(1)=−1; an interior unique simple root yields a strict fold. Both endpoints are excluded; one rate tends to infinity at the right endpoint. Exact witness rates (7/5,28/5),(3/2,15/2) have s=1/3, fourth 19/99, but sixth 95/726 and 2185/16731, so stationary laws differ. Independent symbolic calculation checked rational identities and beta-product moments; it does not substitute for the analytic positivity and uniqueness argument.
